invariants.claim: Burn destinations bypass screening; every successful nonzero update passes the helper before inherited authorization and writes.

A successful nonzero update excludes this raffle, factory, quote token, wrapper, prize token and canonical implementation; addresses with code must additionally be unregistered in the canonical factory.
With nonzero auth, inherited authority is checked against the current stored owner before ownership mutation.
Existing-owner updates clear per-token approval, adjust nonzero-address balances, assign owner, emit Transfer and return the previous owner.
The hook and its callees impose no lifecycle or timestamp condition; transfer callers remain governed by authorization and destination screening.
